cfhgui_veinminer.name: CFHGui Veinminer
cfhgui_veinminer.perm.use: Veinmine: break a whole group of blocks at once
cfhgui_veinminer.perm.admin: Reload the veinminer's rules and run its self-test
cfhgui_veinminer.shape.shapeless.tip: Every connected block of the mined block's kind: a whole ore vein, a whole tree. Deepslate and stone ores count as one, logs join their own wood.
cfhgui_veinminer.shape.tunnel_1x2.tip: A corridor one wide and two tall, straight into the face you mine, as deep as the limit allows.
cfhgui_veinminer.shape.tunnel_3x3.tip: Three by three, straight into the face you mine, as deep as the limit allows.
cfhgui_veinminer.shape.staircase.tip: Steps three tall, the way you face: down when you look a little down, up when you look a little up. Aim at the block in front at eye level.
cfhgui_veinminer.shape.square_3x3.tip: Three by three in the plane of the face you mine, one block deep.
cfhgui_veinminer.shape.column.tip: Straight up or down from the mined block until the column ends: down from a top face, up from a bottom face, the way you look from a side.
cfhgui_veinminer.hud.no_server: Veinminer is not on this server
cfhgui_veinminer.hud.not_allowed: Veinminer is not allowed for you here
cfhgui_veinminer.stopped.tool: Veinmine stopped after %s blocks: your tool is about to break
cfhgui_veinminer.stopped.hungry: Veinmine stopped after %s blocks: you are too hungry
cfhgui_veinminer.stopped.protected: Veinmine stopped after %s blocks: the rest is protected
cfhgui_veinminer.cmd.reloaded: CFHGui Veinminer: rules read again and sent to the players.
cfhgui_veinminer.cmd.may: You may veinmine: hold the Veinminer key (grave by default) and mine.
cfhgui_veinminer.cmd.may_not: You may not veinmine on this server.
cfhgui_veinminer.cmd.limits: Up to %s blocks, %s a tick; shapes: %s
cfhgui_veinminer.cmd.costs: Needs a tool that harvests: %s; hunger per block: %s; stops before the tool breaks: %s; drops: %s
cfhgui_veinminer.selftest.no_room: CFHGui Veinminer self-test: no empty room above you (it needs 32 blocks of air on every side, high up).
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.section.mode.a: Hold the key (grave by default; change it in Controls) and mine one block: its whole group breaks with it. The mouse wheel goes through the shapes while the key is held.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.key.tip: The key that turns veinmining on. Change it in Controls, under CFHGui Veinminer.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.activation.tip: Hold: veinmining is on while the key is held. Toggle: a press turns it on, the next one off.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.scrollCycles.t: While veinmining is on, the mouse wheel goes through the shapes instead of the hotbar. The shape keys in Controls do it too.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.shape.tip: What one block mined takes with it: its whole group (Shapeless), a tunnel, a staircase, a square or a column.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.diagonals.tip: Shapeless veins reach through edges and corners too, not only through faces (if the server allows it).
Logs always reach through edges and corners, so a tree with crooked branches falls whole.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.section.previe: While veinmining is on, what the next block you mine takes with it is outlined in the world.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.preview.tip: Outline every block the next block you mine takes with it.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.previewStyle.t: An outline of the whole group, the outline with its faces tinted, or the tint alone.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.throughWalls.t: The part of the group hidden behind other blocks shows faintly through them.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.color.tip: CFHGui's accent colour (Interface settings), or a colour of your own.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.customColor.ti: The preview's colour when Colour is Custom.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.maxPreview.tip: The outline stops at this many blocks (nearest first); the readout still counts all of them.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.section.hud.ab: A small line by the crosshair: the shape and how many blocks it will break ("Shapeless · 23").
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.hud.tip: The shape and the count, and why nothing would break when nothing would.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.hudPosition.ti: Beside the crosshair, under it, above the hotbar, or in the top left corner.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.section.server: The rules of the worlds this game hosts (singleplayer, open to LAN), in config/slate/veinminer-server.json. A server keeps its own file; while you play on one, its rules show here as it sent them.
This game's own: they apply to the worlds it hosts
The server's: change them in its config/slate/veinminer-server.json
This server has no CFHGui Veinminer
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.permiss: Everyone, or operators only. CFHGui Server's roles can give or take cfhgui_veinminer.use either way.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.maxBloc: The most blocks one use breaks, the mined block included. The file allows up to 4096.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.blocksP: How many blocks break each tick: a big group crumbles over a few ticks instead of all at once.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.require: Only blocks the held item can harvest (that would drop something) are broken. Creative players need no tool.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.exhaust: Exhaustion for each block past the first (4 is one food point; mining a block by hand costs 0.005). With an empty food bar only the mined block breaks. Creative players pay nothing.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.stopBef: The tool wears for every block, as when mining by hand; this keeps its last point of durability.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.drops.t: Where what the group drops goes: all at the block you mined, straight into your inventory, or each where its block was.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.harvest: With veinmining on, right-clicking a ripe crop harvests every ripe crop of that kind joined to it and plants each again (a seed of what it dropped goes back into the ground).
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.toolAct: With veinmining on, what an axe, a hoe or a shovel does to the clicked block (strip a log, till the ground, make a path) is done to its whole group: the tree, or the same ground around it on its level.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.allowDi: Players may let veins reach through edges and corners (their Diagonals settings).
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.allowBl: Chests, furnaces, spawners and machines may be veinmined too.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.allow.t: Blocks (minecraft:stone) and tags (#minecraft:logs) that may be veinmined; empty for every block that can be broken.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.deny.ti: Blocks and tags that are never veinmined, whatever the list above says.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.oreTags: Blocks that share a tag matching one of these count as one vein (c:ores/iron holds both iron ores). * stands for any part of a name.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.deepsla: deepcfhgui_x_ore and x_ore of one mod count as one vein, for mods that tag neither.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.logsByW: A log, its wood and their stripped forms count as one.
cfhgui_veinminer.settings.server.plantsA: Grass, ferns, flowers and other wild plants, a mod's too, break together. Crops, saplings and leaves stay apart.
Each line a group of blocks and tags, separated by commas, that count as one (the giant mushrooms' caps and stems, the fungi's caps and shroomlights).
